description: Is this domain known-bad? Resolves the hostname (A/AAAA), matches the name, its parent domains and resolved IPv4 against ThreatCluster's high-confidence 30-day IOC feed (cached, refreshed about hourly), and looks up ransomware leak-site claims naming the domain (commercially reusable sources via Dragons Eye). Returns verdict listed, claimed, listed_and_claimed or no_known_threat with the matching reports. No match is not proof of safety; claims are unverified attacker assertions. Stale feed or source failure returns an error and is not charged. Costs $0.02 USDC per call via x402 (payment goes in _meta["x402/payment"]); invalid input or an upstream failure returns an error and is not charged.
